story.text: On Christmas Day Laurie opens the parlour {DOOR}: “Here’s another Christmas present for the March family!” It is Father, home from the war, wrapped up in a {MUFFLER}. Everyone {CRIES} at once. Beth runs into his arms, {STRONG} enough at last, and that night he sits in the big {CHAIR}, {PRAISING} each girl in turn.
story.caption: He sat in the big chair
